nodes.text: Five years after COVID-19, a new virus is spreading in China. China has declared a state of emergency as the epidemic overwhelms hospitals & crematoriums. Multiple viruses, including Influenza A, HMPV, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and COVID-19, are spreading rapidly across the country.
